query: Please implement a data visualization analysis website to display crawled data. The website should have functionalities for data display, word cloud, bar chart, pie chart, and linear analysis. Users should be able to browse data, view different types of charts, and perform data analysis. The website should also have data filtering and search functions to help users quickly find the data they need. Choose light cyan for global background and teal for all components.
